verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV has a programmatic surface: API endpoints such as /identity_verification/retry, webhooks for STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED and RETRIED, Link client callbacks, and an official MCP server. However, several key capabilities are documented only in the Dashboard: the no-code Workflow Management editor for building and changing templates, the Override Result button for failed verifications, risk-factor breakdowns, and session status reporting. Missing for 10: evidence of API equivalents for template/workflow creation and editing, result overrides, risk-factor detail and reporting, plus a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
